valid:
run Instance3 {
    some disj User1, User2 : User |
    some disj Photo1, Photo2, Photo3 : Photo |
    some disj Day1, Day2 : Day {
        User = User1 + User2
        Influencer = none
        Photo = Photo1 + Photo2 + Photo3
        Ad = Photo1 + Photo2
        Day = Day1 + Day2
        follows = User1->User2 + User2->User1
        sees = User1->Photo1 + User1->Photo2 + User1->Photo3
             + User2->Photo1 + User2->Photo2 + User2->Photo3
        posts = User1->Photo1 + User1->Photo3 + User2->Photo2
        suggested = none->none
        date = Photo1->Day1 + Photo2->Day2 + Photo3->Day1

} for 2 User, 3 Photo, 2 Day expect 1

parse:
run Negative1 {
    some disj U1, U2, U3 : User | some disj P1 : Photo | some disj D1 : Day {
        User = U1 + U2 + U3
        Influencer = none
        Photo = P1
        Ad = none
        Day = D1

        follows = U1->U2 + U2->U3
        posts = U2->P1
        sees = U1->P1
        suggested = none
        date = P1->D1

        all p: Photo | one u: User | p in u.posts
        no u: User | u in u.follows
        all u: User | u.sees = Ad + (u.follows.posts & (Photo - Ad))
        all u: User | some (u.posts & Ad) implies u.posts in Ad
        all i: Influencer | (User - i) in follows.i
        all i: Influencer, d: Day | some p: Photo | p in i.posts and p.date = d
        all u: User | u.suggested = u.follows.follows - u - u.follows
    }
} for 3 User, 1 Photo, 1 Day expect 0
